title: Provider authorized status must bind a stable license-evidence SHA-256
context: Provider evidence previously required provider.license_status=authorized but did not bind that declaration to a stable provenance identity. A text-only authorization claim could therefore satisfy the structural gate without any machine-checkable reference to the local supporting authorization artifact.

decision.proof_boundary: provenance commitment only; not independent proof of authorization truth or scope
decision.failure_behavior: missing or malformed license evidence hash rejects the evidence as structurally invalid

documentation_note: The machine-readable validator and evidence-format contract are updated. REAL_DATA_PROVIDER_VALIDATION_RUNBOOK.md still needs a wording-only synchronization for the new license hash field; no provider run is permitted to bypass the validator.
